material.acceptance_criteria: After any sequence of orbit deltas, the pitch stays in the documented range and eyeOf(cam)[1] >= 0. Every screen corner used by viewRect maps to a finite ground point.
material.description: render3d.js:5 defines PITCH_LIMIT = PI/2 - 0.01, and orbitCamera at render3d.js:196 clamps pitch to [-PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT], so the lower bound is negative. render3d.js:120 documents pitch as 'above the ground plane', and eyeOf (render3d.js:121-127) puts the eye at target.y + distance*sin(pitch), so a negative pitch puts the eye under the ground. Input reaches it from play.js:1227 (pointermove, button 2 held or shift down, calls renderer3d.orbit) through render3d.js:555. The default pitch is 0.9 rad and the drag rate is 0.005 rad/px (render3d.js:194), so about 180 px of upward right-drag reaches pitch 0 and more reaches the underside. Symptom: the view flips under the map, and screenToWorld (play.js:1107-1125), which feeds the viewport rectangle (moba_input.js:26-41) and every ground click, then casts rays away from the ground.
material.subject: Right-drag orbit can take the camera pitch below the ground plane
material.witness: Re-checked on origin/main (ci-status 194e15a3: 6/6 success, run 40112738370). render3d.js:5 PITCH_LIMIT = PI/2-0.01 and :7 PITCH_MIN = PI/6+0.01; orbitCamera (render3d.js:198) clamps pitch to [PITCH_MIN, PITCH_LIMIT], so the lower bound is positive and eye height stays above the ground. Witness dispatch 1792860044680-6698-40c935ea58cc7143 from its own session. Row resolved on the fix sha 194e15a3, which is an ancestor of origin/main.
